rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken pattern for choosing any option or saying that the result is the same whichever option is chosen.

example.english: Whichever book suits you is fine.
example.jyutping: bin1 bun2 syu1 dou1 ngaam1 nei5 tai2

rows.note: Use this to stress that the outcome is unchanged regardless of which option is involved.

example.jyutping: mou4 leon6 bin1 go3 fong1 faat3 dou1 dak1

rows.traditional: 邊 + CL + N + 都 + PRED
rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice for any or either item, and it also works for no-matter-which when 都 completes the clause.

example.english: You can pick whichever book suits you.
example.jyutping: bin1 bun2 syu1 dou1 ngaam1 nei5

rows.traditional: 無論 + 邊 + CL + N + 都 + PRED
rows.jyutping: mou4 leon6 bin1 CL N dou1 PRED
rows.note: Use this explicit form when stressing that the result is unchanged regardless of which item is chosen.

example.english: The food is just as good at whichever restaurant we choose.
example.traditional: 無論邊間餐廳，啲嘢食都一樣咁好食。
example.jyutping: mou4 leon6 bin1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 dou1 jat1 joeng6 gam3 hou2 sik6

rows.traditional: 邊 + CL + N + V，就 + V
rows.jyutping: bin1 CL N V zau6 V
rows.note: Use this pattern when the action or result depends on which option meets a condition.

example.english: We’ll go into whichever restaurant has a free table.
example.traditional: 邊間餐廳有位，就入邊間。
example.jyutping: bin1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jau5 wai2 zau6 jap6 bin1 gaan1

rows.note: Use this before a following clause when the choice depends on which item has the stated property.

example.english: We take whichever bus is faster.
example.jyutping: bin1 baan1 ce1 faai3 zau6 daap3 bin1 baan1

rows.note: Use this to ask emphatically which particular item it was or is.

example.english: Tell me which book you actually chose, whichever one it was.
example.jyutping: gau3 ging2 bin1 bun2 syu1 hai6 nei5 gaan2 gaa3

rows.note: Use this emphatic question when asking which one exactly or which one on earth.

example.english: Which one exactly is the one you mean, whichever it is?
example.jyutping: gau3 ging2 bin1 go3 hai6 nei5 gong2 go2 go3
